what_would_change_my_mind: Two consecutive quarters of decelerating revenue growth toward the sector average would remove the justification for the multiple premium.

short.rationale: Fundamentals rarely move a stock in a week; only a slight tilt from strong results.

medium.rationale: Next quarter's results should keep confirming the growth rate the price assumes.

long.rationale: 56% revenue growth at a 73.5% gross margin supports the valuation over a year.

comparison_class.definition: High-growth, high-margin semiconductor names trading at a premium to sector median P/E while sustaining >40% YoY revenue growth
comparison_class.why_this_class: closest available analogue for a name whose multiple premium is backed by realised growth, not narrative

thesis: Revenue growth of 56% YoY with a 73.5% gross margin is unusually strong even against this instrument's own history. The P/E and EV/EBITDA premium to sector medians (42.3 vs 28.6, 31.1 vs 19.8) is real but not obviously unsupported given the growth and margin profile. Balance sheet is clean: cash well exceeds total debt, free cash flow is substantial. This seat is weak at short terms by design -- this read matters most at 1y.
